recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core source work is recommended unless a future issue changes canonical binding semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-16055 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request for STU3 asking to drop ElementDefinition.binding.valueSet[x] and rename it to ElementDefinition.binding.valueSet because canonical now covers both explicit ValueSet references and logical/implicit value set identifiers.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git-svn commit 4cd5fe67cd712a5cf12329da39bf088a20b03275 on 2018-06-09, matching the Jira comment's svn revision 13847. That commit changed source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml from ElementDefinition.binding.valueSet[x] with type uri | canonical(ValueSet) to ElementDefinition.binding.valueSet with type canonical(ValueSet), and added the corresponding history entry.
additional_context: ElementDefinition remains an active normative datatype in source/fhir.ini. Current source searches find no remaining old valueSet[x], valueSetUri/valueSetReference, or uri | canonical(ValueSet) patterns in the ElementDefinition datatype, StructureDefinition, profile, or history sources. FHIR-5812 and FHIR-15748 are related background audits already represented on the combined branch and were not decided here.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current core FHIR source already reflects the published Jira decision and no corrective source edit is needed.

related_jiras.note: Earlier ElementDefinition.binding reference[x] to valueSet[x] rename found in git history; already represented on the combined branch and only background for this canonical-only change.
Analogous DataRequirement valueSet canonical audit already represented on the combined branch, but not needed to decide this ElementDefinition issue.
